Method of Attack: Adware capable of pouring fullscreen adverts at regular intervals or when the user unlocks the device
Hides itself and runs in the background
Monitors the lock state of the device
Serves initial fullscreen pop-up ads on launch
Triggers additional fullscreen ads when app buttons are tapped
Pushes ads every 15 or 30 minutes and on device unlock
Prompts users to give five-star ratings to increase visibility
Attack Vector: Google Play Store apps disguised as games, TV streaming apps, or remote controllers
Indicators of Compromise: Apps delivering HidenAd adware show similar behavior despite different developers and certificates
Fullscreen pop-up ads on app launch and button taps
Ads triggered every 15 or 30 minutes and on device unlock
